variants.name: drops-locking
variants.why: removes the locks: no deadlock, but concurrent updates lose money

ledger.py:
first, second = sorted((src, dst), key=lambda acct: acct.id)
    with first.lock:
        time.sleep(0)  # yield, as a real database call would
        with second.lock:
            src.balance -= amount
            dst.balance += amount

b1 = src.balance
    time.sleep(0)
    src.balance = b1 - amount
    b2 = dst.balance
    time.sleep(0)
    dst.balance = b2 + amount
